context: deploy triage with a search section. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail by inspecting the workspace artifacts (stardust/eds-conversion-log.md, content/home.html, the code tree) and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: activated
checklist.description: The stardust `deploy` skill was invoked for the prototype (the session loaded the deploy skill / read its SKILL.md or Step 2 reference and worked from `stardust/prototypes/home-proposed.html`).

checklist.name: hero_is_block
checklist.description: ARTIFACT: `stardust/eds-conversion-log.md` triages the hero section as a block (Block Collection match `hero`), and `content/home.html` contains a block table `<div class="hero">` (or `hero <variant>`) whose cells carry the authored h1, lede and the two CTAs — not default content and not a widget link.

checklist.name: cards_is_block

checklist.name: decision_rule_cited
checklist.description: ARTIFACT: `stardust/eds-conversion-log.md` records, for every section (hero, cards, site-search), both Step 2 triage answers — (1) default content / block / widget and (2) Block Collection match or none — and states the rule that made the search a widget in the skill's terms (no authored content / configuration only / everything arrives from code, index, API or user input → widget; authors fill rows → block), attributing it to the deploy skill's Step 2 (D1) rather than inventing a different reason. The search row must also cite the dynamics inventory (`client-only` / `search-index-backed`).

checklist.description: ARTIFACT: no code was written — no `blocks/` directory (in particular no `blocks/widget/`, `blocks/search/` or `blocks/site-search/`), no `widgets/` directory, and `scripts/scripts.js` is unchanged (still exactly 144 lines, still containing the stock `buildWidgetAutoBlocks` and ending with `loadPage();`, no added lines). The widget file stem named in the content page / log is not a reserved EDS class (`widget`, `section`, `block`, `wrap`, `button`, or ending `-wrapper` / `-container`).

checklist.name: no_site_names
checklist.description: ARTIFACT: `stardust/eds-conversion-log.md` and `content/home.html` name no real-world site, brand or hostname — only the fixture's role names ("a regional public-library network"), `example.com` placeholders and, if at all, the `aem.live` documentation host.
